title: DiG-bench: Discovery in Games
abstract: arXiv:2608.12593v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discovery---formulating novel generalizations---is a central part of the scientific process. Despite its importance, there is a gap in the current AI benchmark landscape, with few benchmarks directly probing the capacity for discovering new knowledge with experimentation in controlled environments where the objective is unknown. To address this gap, we release a new benchmark: DiG-bench (Discovery in Games). DiG-bench consists of a set of 70 independent games. Each game is encoded as a short string and has unique transformation rules that must be discovered through interaction and experimentation. The levels of the game present a series of challenges to test whether the rules have been discovered, where the win conditions for each level are also unknown. We provide games at seven tiers of difficulty for AI agents. The lowest tier is routinely solvable by multiple models, while the highest tier challenges the best models in agentic harnes

translated_abstract: 发现——即提出新颖的概括——是科学过程的核心部分。尽管其重要性不言而喻，但在当前AI基准测试领域中仍存在空白，很少有基准测试能直接在受控环境中（且目标未知）评估通过实验发现新知识的能力。为填补这一空白，我们发布了一个新基准：DiG-bench（游戏中的发现）。DiG-bench包含70个独立游戏，每个游戏编码为短字符串，并具有独特的变换规则，这些规则必须通过交互和实验来发现。游戏关卡呈现一系列挑战，以测试规则是否已被发现，且每个关卡的胜利条件也是未知的。我们为AI代理提供了七个难度等级的游戏。最低等级可由多种模型常规解决，而最高等级则挑战了代理框架中最优秀的模型。
tldr: 我们推出了DiG-bench基准，包含70个独立游戏，旨在通过未知规则和未知胜利条件的交互实验，评估AI在受控环境中的科学发现能力，并设置了七个难度等级以挑战不同水平的模型。
en_tdlr: We introduce DiG-bench, a benchmark of 70 independent games with unknown rules and win conditions, designed to evaluate AI's scientific discovery ability through interactive experimentation in controlled environments, spanning seven difficulty tiers.
